display.purpose: Used for highly stylized screen titles, secret role declarations, and massive countdown timers.

body.purpose: Used for standard settings text, lists, buttons, and instructional pass-around sheets.

shadows.name: sketchy-offset
shadows.purpose: A custom outline offset drawn to the bottom-right in solid black, giving hand-drawn depth.

motion.name: spring-scale
motion.purpose: Physical compression animation triggered when any button or card is tapped down.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: Defines the maximum container width to constrain the layout on tablets and web previewers.

components.name: AppButton
components.description: Tactile button utilizing a hand-drawn paper webp texture as its background. Animates down on active tap and emits a light haptic impact.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-image: url('assets/images/paper_texture.webp'); background-size: 100% 100%; border: none; width: 100%; height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'ArefRuqaa', serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: #4c2d09; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: AppSketchyCard
components.description: Rugged card painted dynamically with imperfect border lines, supporting an option masking-tape overlay for the evidence-board aesthetic.
components.css: .ds-sketchy-card { position: relative; width: 260px; height: 160px; border: 2px solid #c3a24b; background-color: #000000; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 25px; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-sketchy-card:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'ArefRuqaa', serif; font-size: 45px; font-weight: 700; color: #c3a24b; } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -12px; width: 80px; height: 24px; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); transform: rotate(-2deg); }

narrative.overview: Imposter's design system is an expressive, highly physical visual language that blends raw, organic, sketchy elements with rich calligraphic heritage. The entire interface feels like a tangible desktop game made of hand-cut cardboard, torn paper sheets, and rough graphite doodles.

rules.name: The Rarity of Gold Rule
rules.body: Desert Gold (#c3a24b) is a powerful, saturated brand asset. It should cover no more than 15% of any screen surface, standing out sharply against the absolute black backdrop to direct the player's eye immediately.

rules.name: The Calligraphic Dominance Rule
rules.body: Every visual text element in the game must use ArefRuqaa. Standard system sans-serif is only permitted as a fallback in platform exceptions, preserving the immersive visual world.

rules.name: The Flat-Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Soft, blurry drop-shadows are banned. All elevations are represented by drawing solid offset outlines or stacking hand-cut paper layers with black margins.

dos: Do use ArefRuqaa for all display text and Arabic game commands.
Do incorporate HapticFeedback.lightImpact() on all custom button taps to give physical confirmation.
Do draw custom outlines with SketchyCardPainter to represent card segments and frames.
Do use thick borders and golden highlights to maintain high readability in low-light gathering settings.
donts: Don't use standard material default rounded buttons or clean flat gray grids (avoids the SaaS Cliché).
Don't use neon gradients or soft drop-shadow blurs (avoids the Neon Cyberpunk style).
Don't allow text blocks to expand beyond 65 characters without proper horizontal margins (maintains Pass-Around legibility).
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as a colored accent on lists or cards (banned pattern).
